'''Deluge Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|
<b>Attack Interval</b>: {{Color|5|7}}s<br>
<b>Mode of Attack</b>: Fires a stream of deluge at approaching enemies. The stream pushes back small and medium enemies along the direction of the attack.
|A disrupting facility furnished with a fluid pressurization module. If you hope to avoid the "overwhelming momentum" of a Tide Surge, please do not face it directly.}}
